                                        LAPTOP POLICY

To support your work at Lyzr, the company will reimburse the cost of a standard company laptop
for eligible U.S. employees, in accordance with the policy outlined below. Any applicable sales
taxes on the approved laptop purchase will be borne by Lyzr Inc.

1. Approved Models & Cost Limits

Employees must purchase laptops only from the approved models listed below:


 Employee          Approved      Screen       Unified    Storage     Budget Cap (USD)
 Category          Spec          Size         Memory


 Non-Tech          MacBook Air   13”          16 GB      256 GB      $1000
 (Sales,Ops,       M4 (10-core
 etc.)             CPU, 8-core
                   GPU)


 Tech              MacBook Air   13” or 15”   24 GB      512 GB      $1,400
 (Engineering)     M4 (10-core
                   CPU,
                   10-core
                   GPU)


 Senior            MacBook Air   15”          16–24 GB   512 GB      $1,200
 Leadership (VP,   M4 (10-core
 Director, CXO)    CPU,
                   10-core
                   GPU)




The total purchase price (excluding applicable taxes) must be within the approved cost limits.
Any amount exceeding the approved cap will not be reimbursed.

AppleCare Coverage: AppleCare may be purchased separately by employees for their
company-issued MacBooks and will be reimbursed by the company upon submission of a valid
invoice, for a maximum coverage period of three (3) years from the date of issue.
2. Purchase & Reimbursement Process

   ●​   Employees should purchase the laptop directly.
   ●​   The invoice must be issued in the employee’s name.
   ●​   The receipt must be submitted through the reimbursement process for payment.
   ●​   Reimbursement will be processed after verification of the invoice and confirmation that
        the purchase complies with the approved cost limits.

3. Ownership & Return of Equipment

Although the laptop is purchased by the employee, it remains the property of Lyzr Inc.​
The laptop must be returned to the company at the time of exit, regardless of the reason for
separation.​
Failure to return the laptop may result in recovery of the asset value from final payments.

All laptops purchased under this policy remain the property of Lyzr Inc and are governed by the
Employee Handbook. The asset is depreciated over a 3‑year (36‑month) period. Upon
resignation or exit, the employee may either return the laptop or choose to buy it at the
depreciated value. For example, if the laptop has been used for 6 months, the buyback amount
will be calculated as 6/36 of the original asset value. If the employee does not wish to purchase
it, the laptop must be returned to the company in good working condition.

4. Usage & Care

The laptop is provided strictly for official business use and must be maintained in good working
condition. Employees are responsible for the safe handling and care of the device.

If you have any questions about the process or approved models, please reach out to the
People Team.
